item.title: Shallow M5.6 earthquake kills one and damages dozens of homes in Gilgit-Baltistan, Pakistan
item.description: A shallow M5.6 earthquake struck near Barishal, Gilgit-Baltistan, at 11:21 LT (06:21 UTC) on January 19, 2026, damaging multiple homes, killing one person, and injuring two. Multiple landslides were also reported, with debris blocking multiple routes across the region and surrounding areas. Source

item.title: CME impact causes G4 – Severe geomagnetic storm, amazing aurora across USA and Europe
item.description: The impact of a full halo coronal mass ejection (CME) at Earth on January 19, 2026, drove geomagnetic activity to G4 - Severe levels, producing widespread aurora across Europe, Asia, and the United States. Source

item.title: Major winter storm forecast to impact central and eastern United States this weekend
item.description: A major winter storm is forecast to sweep across much of the central and eastern United States between January 23 and 25, 2026, with a mix of snow, sleet, and ice likely from Texas and the Mid-South to the Northeast. Dangerous travel and freezing rain are expected in several regions as the system intensifies through the weekend. Source

item.title: Snow cover seen on Saharan sand dunes in Aïn Séfra, Algeria
item.description: Light snow began covering Saharan sand dunes in Aïn Séfra in Algeria on January 17, 2026, and continues to do so, forming a scenic contrast with the barren sands of the desert, which has been going viral on social media. Source

item.title: Major winter storm forecast to bring heavy snow, sleet, and freezing rain to the southern U.S.
item.description: A major winter storm will bring widespread snow, sleet, and freezing rain from the Southern Plains to the Mid-Atlantic between Friday, January 23, and Sunday, January 25, 2026. Source

item.title: Red heavy rain warnings issued as prolonged rainfall event impacts New Zealand
item.description: Prolonged heavy rain affecting New Zealand prompted MetService to raise heavy rain warnings to the highest alert level at 09:08 LT on January 21, 2026, amid a multi-day rainfall event and the influence of a tropical low. Source

item.title: Winter storm watches in effect across central and southern United States
item.description: Winter storm watches are in effect from New Mexico and Texas to Arkansas, Tennessee, and Kentucky, from Friday morning through late Saturday night, January 23–24, 2026, with some extending into Sunday afternoon, January 25. Heavy snow, sleet, and ice accumulations are forecast, along with dangerously cold temperatures that will persist into Monday morning, January 26. Source

item.title: Tourist helicopter wreckage found near Mount Aso crater after disappearance, Japan
item.description: A sightseeing helicopter carrying two Taiwanese tourists and a Japanese pilot was found wrecked near the crater of Mount Aso in Kumamoto Prefecture, southwestern Japan, on January 20, 2026, after disappearing during a short flight earlier the same day. Rescue operations have been severely hampered by dense volcanic gas emissions and poor visibility around the active crater. Source

item.title: Extreme cold watches expand as Arctic outbreak spreads across central United States
item.description: A large and prolonged outbreak of Arctic air is spreading across the United States, prompting extreme cold watches across much of the northern and central United States from Thursday, January 22, 2026, through Friday, January 24. This Arctic outbreak will bring one of the most dangerous cold spells in recent years, with the greatest threat lasting from Thursday night through early Saturday morning. Source

item.title: Strong and shallow M6.1 earthquake hits Volcano Islands, Japan region
item.description: A strong and shallow earthquake registered by the USGS as M6.1 hit the Volcano Islands, Japan region at 16:37 UTC on January 21, 2026. The agency is reporting a depth of 25.5 km (15.8 miles). EMSC is reporting the same magnitude and depth. Source
